ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Access Tool - Team Viewer Session Started On Linux Host
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the command line executed when TeamViewer starts a session started by a remote host.
Once a connection has been started, an investigator can verify the connection details by viewing the "incoming_connections.txt" log file in the TeamViewer folder.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\/TeamViewer\\_Service$") AND process_path = RGX("\\/TeamViewer\\_Desktop$") AND process_command_line = RGX("\\/TeamViewer\\_Desktop\\ \\-\\-IPCport\\ 5939\\ \\-\\-Module\\ 1$"))
